lines.text: You totally rock it in that hat!

data.define: To look great in something or do well.

example.text: You totally rock it in that hat!

misuse.text: Don't say 'rock it' about an actual rock.

publish.title: What does "rock it" mean?
publish.value: Rock it = Wear it with confidence. Example: "You totally rock it in that hat!" (casual English).
